# Phase Three — Exact Current Plan

## Immediate Runtime Proof
- Discover the real local server command/active port.
- Open a representative product at mobile width.
- Verify commerce-004 loads, Radiance panel renders, anonymous state is truthful, console is clean, and action catalog returns 80 public actions.

## First Revenue Infrastructure After Runtime
- Generate static crawlable Apps/Games product inventory from canonical registries.
- Generate canonical/OG/JSON-LD/sitemap metadata from the same product truth.
- Add product-readiness tests so missing route/capability/SEO/mobile evidence blocks release.
- Add privacy-safe funnel events around store open, credit-pack intent, Radiance unlock success/failure, and return-after-purchase.

## Write Law
Every existing source is fully read before whole-file rewrite. Every touched JS/MJS starts with exact B"H prologue, uses tabs, extensive JSDoc, readable statements, and remains strictly below 120 lines by extraction rather than compression.
